title: Design Engineer
description:
ABOUT TRADEIFY

Tradeify is a fast-growing futures trading company built to help traders access the tools, technology, and opportunities they need to succeed. We combine a trader-first approach with modern technology to create a reliable, transparent, and engaging experience for our growing community.

We operate at the intersection of finance and technology, and we move quickly. Our team is driven by a shared belief that better tools and experiences create better traders - and we are building those experiences every day.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Tradeify is looking for a Design Engineer - a hybrid designer/builder who is proficient with both AI-native tools as well as traditional design software. You'll move from concept to shippable code fast, using AI to generate visual directions, prototype interactions, and write production-ready front-end code, all with strong design judgment guiding every step.

You'll support work across our website, digital products, and brands - but where a traditional designer hands off a mockup, you'll be prototyping and sometimes shipping your own solutions. This is an excellent opportunity for a designer-who-codes (or a developer with real design taste) who wants to work at the frontier of AI-assisted creation and development, under the guidance of our Head of Design as well as various stakeholders.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Design + Build

- Design and build landing page sections, page variants, and marketing website experiences directly in code

- Create and ship polished product UI for smaller features, enhancements, and design tickets - going from concept to working front end without a traditional design-to-dev handoff

- Produce brand collateral such as presentations, social graphics, campaign visuals, and other creative assets using AI generation and editing tools

- Work within established brand and design systems while maintaining consistency across touchpoints

- Apply strong typography, hierarchy, layout, color, and visual/content design principles - regardless of the tool used to produce the output

- Structure web experiences around what visitors already know, what they need, and the actions they're trying to take

AI-Native Workflow

- Use AI tools (LLMs, image/video/3D generation, AI coding assistants) as your primary design and development environment - not just a supplement to Figma

- Rapidly explore multiple creative directions by generating and iterating with AI rather than manual compositions

- Use AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, v0, or similar) to turn concepts directly into working, responsive front-end code

- Pressure-test ideas quickly, prototype in the browser, and iterate based on real interaction rather than static mockups

- Apply strong judgment about where AI accelerates the work and where hands-on craft and review are still required

- Stay current with new AI design/dev tools and bring the useful ones into the team's workflow

Roadmap and Growth Initiatives

- Contribute to new products, features, and business initiatives

- Support marketing website and product improvements end-to-end, from idea to shipped code

- Help design and implement conversion and UX optimizations

- Partner with senior designers and engineers on larger, more complex projects

- Use feedback, available data, and business context to refine your work

Collaboration and Execution

- Clarify small or underspecified briefs by asking thoughtful questions and defining scope

- Explain the reasoning behind your design and technical decisions, including directions considered and rejected

- Communicate progress clearly in an asynchronous, remote environment

- Document decisions and keep work organized (code repos, prompt libraries, brand assets) so others can easily follow and continue it

- Manage multiple assignments and deliver high-quality, shipped work in a fast-moving environment

- Incorporate feedback quickly and keep projects moving once direction is set

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

title: Senior Software Engineer – BMaaS & Datacenter Networking
description:
About the Team
Our engineering team builds next-generation, cloud-native bare-metal orchestration platforms for AI neo-cloud environments. We operate on a T-shaped engineering model: while each engineer brings deep expertise in a primary domain, every team member maintains practical fluency across neighboring systems. This shared foundation enables rigorous design reviews, effective cross-domain code reviews, and dependable on-call coverage. Our development is fundamentally based on open-source projects, and contributing to them is a major part of our work.
We develop primary control plane software in Rust and Go, leverage Kubernetes operators, and foster an OpenTelemetry-first operational culture.
Role Overview
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer who combines strong software architecture principles with deep technical domain expertise in Datacenter Networking and DPU architectures. Fitting into our T-shaped engineering model, you will drive the development of control planes powering high-density, high-throughput infrastructure for AI training and inference workloads. Familiarity with automated bare-metal provisioning and lifecycle management is a strong asset.
Core Responsibilities

• Control Plane Development: Design, build, and maintain production-grade control plane microservices, custom Kubernetes operators, and robust reconciliation engines in Rust and Go.

• Architecture & API Design: Author clear Functional (FR) and Non-Functional Requirements (NFR), architectural specs, system sequence diagrams, and clean gRPC/Protobuf and REST API schemas.

• Network Integration: Develop custom integration modules and integrations for modern network operating systems (SONiC, NVUE, Cumulus) and DPU hardware platforms.

• Observability & Diagnostics: Instrument services end-to-end using OpenTelemetry (OTel) traces and metrics, performing systematic root-cause analysis across polyglot distributed systems.

• Quality & Engineering Excellence: Participate in rigorous, review-gated pull request workflows across Rust, Go, and SQL codebases while ensuring high test coverage via mock-driven testing.

Technical Qualifications

• Language Proficiency: Primary mastery of Rust (Tokio async runtime, Tonic, Axum, sqlx) and strong proficiency in Go.

title: OrioleDB Deployment Engineer (AMER)
description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a OrioleDB Deployment Engineer to join our OrioleDB Team and help elevate our OrioleDB offering. You’ll work closely with the OrioleDB team, playing an instrumental role in technical decision-making and refining internal methodologies.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- Package software into our supabase/postgres repo using Nix (with flakes), and help us transition our packaging from traditional to Nix packaging more over time.

- Manage OrioleDB release lifecycles, ensuring timely major, minor, and extension upgrades.

- Expand platform release systems to allow developers to increasingly self-service.

- Optimize CI/CD and tooling, specifically expanding GitHub Actions, team tooling, and testing/release approaches.

- Resolve production issues by proactively identifying and fixing problems in customer deployments.

- Maintain best practices and tests to ensure enhanced stability and decreased deployment risks.

- co-owning the integration of OrioleDB into the supabase product

YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

- Have 3+ years of experience with PostgreSQL and its ecosystem, including extensions and performance optimization.

- Are an Infrastructure Expert with proven experience in management, tooling, and optimization.

- Are proficient in the Nix package management system (including flakes) alongside Ansible, Packer, Docker, QEMU/KVM, AWS, and Kubernetes.

- Have experience building for multiple architectures, specifically Linux and Darwin/macOS aarch64 targets.

- Are comfortable with polyglot environments, including builds for C/C++, Go, JavaScript, and Rust-based projects.

- Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences, especially when interacting with customers.

- Have experience in async or globally distributed teams and value independent, proactive problem-solving.

- Are willing to mentor, taking on responsibility for teaching the engineering team to use and contribute to our Nix-based work.

- Have experience with integration of emerging features into widely used managed hosted product platforms

WHAT WE OFFER

- Fully Remote

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- ESOP

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- Tech Allowance

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment-laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- Health Benefits

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- Annual Off-Sites

Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- Flexible Work

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- Professional Development

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning-courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- 200+ team members

- 40+ countries

- 15+ languages spoken

- $496M raised

- 430,000+ community members

- 30,000+ memes posted (and counting)

We move fast

description:
MANAGER, GROUP REPORTING

ABOUT RADIANT

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll be the trusted voice on group financial information, the person execs call when they need to understand true profitability across entities and clusters, the person investors rely on for accurate consolidated numbers, and the leader building a world-class reporting function from the ground up. You'll scale the growing Group Reporting team and drive processes that keep pace with rapid business expansion. If you're an ambitious accountant who thrives in fast-moving environments and wants to be a core part of building Radiant's financial infrastructure, this is your role.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build and own the consolidated financial reporting engine from the ground up, designing processes and systems that will scale with Radiant. Enable the exec team and board to make rapid capital allocation decisions with confidence in the numbers.

- Lead month-end and year-end close cycles that keep pace with rapid growth, consolidating entities across multiple jurisdictions while maintaining audit-ready quality.

Discord is where the world's gamers hang out, and increasingly, it's the platform game developers build on. We're seeking a Senior Data Science Manager to lead Data Science for our Developer Platform: the SDKs, identity systems, and developer tools that connect games and their players to Discord.

What makes this role distinctive is the two-sided value equation at the heart of the platform. For game developers, we build tools that help studios grow player engagement and revenue, including data products that give them deeper insight into their players and communities. For players, we use signals from those same tools to make it easier to play and hang out with friends, deepen engagement across Discord, and deliver more relevant ads. 

Your team's job is to make both sides of that exchange demonstrably valuable. That means proving the platform's worth to developers with rigorous evidence, and ensuring the signals it generates create outsized, responsible value for Discord users.

If helping make Discord an even better place to hang out with your friends and communities sounds like an exciting challenge - we'd love to chat with you!

• Drive platform adoption by partnering with Product, Engineering, and Business Development to measure integration health, forecast growth, and surface insights that help the org land and deepen integrations with the world's largest game developers.

• Serve as a trusted analytical partner to top game developers, designing joint studies with partner data science teams to uncover business value from the developer tech stack.

• Partner with Data Engineering, Product, and Legal on data governance: ensure platform signals are documented, discoverable, and governed well across Discord.

• Set clear priorities and nimble operating models, and build a team known for rigorous methods and decision-ready work. Partner with other Data leaders to shape the direction and culture of Discord's Data organization..

What you should have

• 8+ years of experience in applied data science and advanced analytics, ideally including both consumer product and B2B or platform contexts.

• 3+ years managing and developing teams of Data Scientists, with a track record of growing ICs and raising the team's technical bar.

• Strong expertise in experimentation and causal inference, including quasi-experimental methods (propensity matching, synthetic controls, diff-in-diff) for settings where randomized experiments aren't feasible.

• Experience designing novel, interpretable metrics for a new or fast-evolving product area, and building the measurement systems around them.

description:
The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!

About Media Research Center:
 
The Media Research Center (MRC) is America’s premier media watchdog. Since 1987, MRC has exposed left-wing bias in news and pop culture, defended free speech, and fought Big Tech censorship of conservatives. With powerful tools like its TV news archive and CensorTrack database, MRC provides hard evidence of bias and censorship. We educate the public and shape the national conversation across platforms that generate over 500 million weekly impressions.
 
About the role 
Are you passionate about protecting free speech and calling out censorship in the digital age? The Media Research Center is seeking a Free Speech America Intern to join the team working to expose Big Tech’s suppression of conservative voices. As an intern, you will help monitor censorship trends across major platforms like Google, Facebook, and X/Twitter, while researching and compiling examples of bias for publication and outreach.
 
This is a hands-on opportunity for students and recent graduates who want to be part of the fight to hold Big Tech accountable and inform the public about the growing threat to online expression.
 
This internship is designed for students and recent graduates. The position is in-person only at MRC headquarters; remote work is not available.
 

Stand Together Fellowships believes that diversity in experiences, perspectives, knowledge and ideas fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success. title: Manufacturing FE Analyst
description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Finite Element Analyst to support the development, industrialization, and manufacturing of large composite aerospace structures. This role will focus on applying finite element analysis (FEA) to manufacturing-driven engineering problems and supporting the rapid transition of composite structures from design through tooling, process development, qualification, production ramp, and sustaining manufacturing. 

The ideal candidate combines strong structural analysis fundamentals with practical knowledge of composite structures and manufacturing. This is a hands-on engineering role working closely with Composite Product Engineering, Process Engineering, Tooling, Materials, NDT, Quality, and Production.

  Key Responsibilities:

• Develop and execute finite element models of large CFRP monolithic and sandwich structures, including cylindrical shells, beams, panels, bonded assemblies, and structural interfaces.

• Support NCR/MRB activities by providing timely analytical assessment and technical substantiation for use-as-is, rework, and repair dispositions.

• Support manufacturing-driven structural definition and Design for Manufacturing (DFM) trade studies by evaluating alternative geometries, laminate configurations, joints, interfaces, and manufacturing concepts.

• Analyze composite laminates using appropriate orthotropic material models, ply definitions, failure criteria, and sandwich/core representations.

• Perform linear and nonlinear static, buckling, contact, local stress, stiffness, and stability analyses as required.

• Evaluate manufacturing and assembly load cases, including tooling support, lifting and handling, transportation, fixturing, clamping, drilling, bonding, and assembly operations.

• Perform thermal and thermo-mechanical analyses associated with composite manufacturing processes, including tool/part CTE mismatch, thermal gradients, spring-in/spring-back, distortion, and dimensional stability.

• Analyze composite tooling and fixtures, including mandrels, bond fixtures, drill/trim fixtures, handling fixtures, and large manufacturing tools for stiffness, deformation, thermal behavior, and load capability.

• Support dimensional-control and tolerance activities by evaluating the effects of tooling deformation, manufacturing loads, thermal effects, and structural flexibility on final part geometry.

• Evaluate manufacturing nonconformances and proposed repairs, including thickness deviations, laminate defects, disbonds, machining damage, holes, inserts, bonded doublers, and other manufacturing-induced conditions.

• Develop local/global models and submodels as required to accurately evaluate manufacturing defects, geometric discontinuities, interfaces, and local stress concentrations.

  Qualifications

  Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

Experience:

• 3+ years of finite element analysis experience in aerospace, composites, or other high-performance structural applications.

• Strong experience with commercial FEA tools such as Abaqus, ANSYS, Nastran/Patran, Simcenter 3D/NX Nastran, or equivalent.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced manufacturing environment and provide timely, technically sound engineering recommendations.

• Strong technical communication and documentation skills

Preferred Qualifications: 

• Experience with large aerospace composite shells, cylinders, beams, panel

title: Technologist R&D Engineer — Optical Design & Computational Photonics
description:
The next era of intelligent systems will require entirely new approaches to photonic device design, optical architectures, simulation, and system integration. Solving these problems demands deep physical intuition, advanced computational modeling, and the ability to bridge simulation with experimental reality.
We are looking for a Principal R&D Engineer to lead advanced optical design and computational photonics development for next-generation semiconductor and photonic systems.
This role combines:

• optical simulation,

• inverse design,

• electro-thermal modeling,

• computational optimization,

• experimental interpretation,

• and system-level co-development.

You will define and drive the optical architecture behind advanced device platforms and work across multidisciplinary teams spanning device physics, packaging, process development, characterization, and system integration.
What you’ll be doing:

• Lead advanced optical and multiphysics simulation activities for next-generation photonic systems.

• Develop inverse-design and optimization methodologies for complex optical structures.

• Build scalable computational frameworks spanning optics, thermal, and electrical domains.

• Drive architecture-level tradeoff studies and system-level optical design decisions.

• Collaborate closely with characterization teams to correlate simulations with experimental measurements.

• Support co-development between devices, packaging, thermal systems, and photonic integration platforms.

• Develop reduced-order analytical models alongside full numerical simulation workflows.

• Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across optical design and simulation activities.

• Help define future AI-assisted computational photonics workflows and design infrastructure.

What we need to see:

• PhD or equivalent experience in Physics, Photonics, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related field.

• 8+ years experience in optical design, computational photonics, or advanced device simulation.

• Strong background in optical simulation and numerical modeling.

• Experience with electromagnetic, optical, thermal, or multiphysics simulation tools.

• Strong programming capability in Python, MATLAB, or scientific computing environments.

• Ability to connect theoretical modeling with experimental validation and engineering constraints.

• Strong technical leadership and communication skills.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Experience with inverse design or optimization algorithms.

• Experience with semiconductor or integrated photonic devices.

• Strong multiphysics modeling capability.

• AI/ML-assisted simulation or optimization experience.

• Experience bridging device-level and system-level optical design.

• Demonstrated ability to solve difficult first-principles engineering problems.

We're hiring a Business & Data Analyst to support the consolidation of an acquired screening platform into Veremark . You'll work under the direction of our M&A PMO, delivering analysis and data tasks against our established integration playbook.
Veremark is a background screening and workforce trust technology company. Employers use us to run pre-employment checks, to verify criminal records, right to work, references, identity, credit and more, through our platform and integrate us with their ATS and HR systems.
You'll sit in the PMO's lean core team, taking direction from the Program Director and supporting the operations, HR and finance leads, product and engineering. It's a hybrid role: half business analysis (processes, requirements, gap analysis), half hands-on data (profiling, reconciliation, reporting). It's a great fit if you've been a BA or data analyst for a few years and want broad exposure to a real M&A integration.
You'll pick up tasks from the Program Director and workstream leads, following our existing M&A integration playbook and flagging anything that doesn't fit.
Platform consolidation

• Help map the acquired platform: check types, workflows, candidate journeys, client configurations and edge cases.

• Carry out gap analysis against Veremark 's product using the playbook templates, and present findings for decision.

• Keep the migration plan and tracker up to date: cohorts, cut-over dates, dependencies and actions.

• Document current and future-state processes, and draft requirements and user stories for review.

Integrations and billing

• Build and maintain the inventory of ATS/HRIS integrations, API consumers and webhooks, and each client's migration status.

• Help map products, price books and contract terms onto Veremark 's pricing, flagging anything that looks off.

• Support Finance with billing reconciliation through cut-over.

Data, validation and reporting

• Profile the acquired platform's data with SQL: volumes, usage by client, active vs. dormant accounts, data quality.

• Help build field-level mappings between the two data models, and test migrated data against them.

• Run the validation and reconciliation queries on each client cohort, and log and chase data issues.

• Maintain the migration dashboard and prepare data for PMO reporting.

• Use AI tools to speed up the work: summarising legacy docs, drafting mappings, cleansing and classifying data.

• Pull usage and revenue data to help the PMO prioritise which clients move first.

Customers and stakeholders

• Provide data and client lists to Customer Success and Sales for migration comms.

• Contribute progress, issues and data to the Program Director's weekly update.

• Follow Compliance guidance on consent, data residency and audit when handling migrated data.

Must have

• 2+ years as a business analyst, business systems analyst or data analyst, ideally in B2B SaaS.

• Worked on a platform migration, system implementation or integration project as part of a team.

• Solid SQL (joins, CTEs, aggregations): comfortable writing your own queries to profile and reconcile data.

• Core BA skills: process mapping, gap analysis, data mapping, requirements and user stories, UAT.

• Some experience building dashboards or reports in a BI tool (e.g. Looker, Metabase, Power BI).

• Curious about how systems fit together, and confident asking engineers about data models, APIs and integrations.

• Comfortable working to direction and a set playbook, and knowing when to flag an issue rather than guess.

• Meticulous and organised, with a strong eye for detail and data accuracy.

• Clear communicator who can explain data to non-technical people.

Nice to have

• Exposure to pricing, contracts or billing data.

• Experience in background screening, HR tech, RegTech or another regulated industry.

• Familiarity with ATS/HRIS platforms (e.g. Workday, SuccessFactors, Greenhouse, Bullhorn).

• Working knowledge of GDPR, data residency and audit requirem

title: Licensed Vocational Nurse (PRN)
description:
Licensed Vocational Nurse (PRN)
Job description Nurturing Home Healthcare is seeking a compassionate and dependable Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) (PRN) to provide skilled nursing care to patients in their homes.
The LVN will work under the supervision of a Registered Nurse (RN) and in collaboration with physicians and interdisciplinary healthcare teams to deliver high-quality patient care, promote positive health outcomes, and support patients in maintaining independence in their home environment.
The ideal candidate is clinically competent, organized, and passionate about delivering exceptional care while ensuring compliance with agency policies, physician orders, and regulatory requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Provide skilled nursing services to home health patients according to physician orders and established care plans. Monitor and assess patient conditions, reporting significant changes to the supervising RN and physician. Administer prescribed medications and treatments safely and accurately. Perform wound care, catheter care, ostomy care, and other skilled nursing procedures as permitted by licensure. Educate patients and caregivers regarding medications, disease management, safety precautions, and treatment plans. Document patient visits, observations, interventions, and outcomes accurately and timely. Assist with the implementation and monitoring of individualized care plans. Collaborate with Registered Nurses, physicians, therapists, and other healthcare professionals to coordinate patient care. Observe infection control practices and maintain patient confidentiality. Participate in team meetings, case conferences, and quality improvement initiatives as needed. Ensure compliance with Medicare guidelines, agency policies, and nursing standards. Support patients and families by providing compassionate care and promoting health, comfort, and independence.
Required Qualifications
Current and active Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) License in the State of Texas. Minimum of one (1) year of nursing experience. Strong clinical assessment and patient care skills. Knowledge of basic nursing procedures and medication administration. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work independently and manage assigned patient visits efficiently. Reliable transportation, valid driver's license, and proof of automobile insurance. Current CPR certification or ability to obtain upon hire. Ability to maintain accurate and timely clinical documentation. Strong organizational and time-management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Previous Home Health experience. Experience working with Medicare patients. Familiarity with home health regulations and documentation requirements. Experience using WellSky (Kinnser) or other electronic medical record systems. Knowledge of chronic disease management and geriatric patient care. Experience with wound care and post-acute care services. Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred. Strong understanding of patient education and caregiver support techniques.
Physical Requirements
Ability to travel regularly between patient homes within the assigned service area. Ability to stand, walk, bend, kneel, crouch, and reach during patient care activities. Ability to lift, transfer, push, or pull up to 50 pounds with appropriate assistance when necessary. Ability to use nursing equipment and perform hands-on patient care procedures. Ability to operate a computer, tablet, and mobile devices for documentation and communication. Visual acuity sufficient to assess patient conditions, administer treatments, and review documentation. Manual dexterity required for medication administration, wound care, and nursing procedures. Ability to work in various home environments and conditions. Ability to perform repetitive tasks such as typing, writing, and documentation throughout the workday.

title: Remote Phone Sales Representative (US Based) - Base Pay plus Commission
description:
Company: ISFY (I Sell For You) -
Location: Remote, United States
Pay: Base pay plus commission

What you are joining:
ISFY is building the Uber of sales. Our software matches people who want to sell with US brands that need sales. Brands connect their abandoned carts and warm shoppers to our platform, and the platform routes them to independent reps who call, help the shopper and close the sale.

This is an early-stage startup. You will be one of the first reps on a new marketplace for remote selling: you choose your hours, work from home, sell for well-known US brands in e-commerce, skincare and beauty, health and wellbeing, and telehealth, and get paid on every sale you close. Early reps help shape the product and get first access to new brands as we grow.

About the role
ISFY helps US ecommerce brands recover sales. Every day, shoppers start an order online, add the product to the cart, and then stop before they pay. Our sales representatives call those shoppers and help them finish the order.

You are not making cold calls. The shopper already chose the product. Your job is to answer their questions, remove the doubt, and close the sale.

What you will do
- Call shoppers who started an online order with one of our US ecommerce brand partners
- Listen, answer questions about the product and the offer, and help the shopper complete the purchase
- Record each call outcome in our system
- Follow our call scripts and our rules on honesty and respect for the customer

What we offer
- Base pay plus commission on every sale you close
- Remote work from anywhere in the United States
- Flexible schedule, agreed with your team leader
- Paid training before your first call, and coaching every week
- A live dashboard where every sale you make shows the same day
- No fees, no leads to buy, and nothing to pay to start

What we look for
- You are based in the United States and authorized to work in the United States
- Clear spoken English
